items.title: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available

sentences.en: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available.
sentences.zh: 针对私有来源的Cloudflare服务现已全面推出。

sentences.en: Today, Cloudflare services for private origins is generally available.
sentences.zh: 如今，针对私有来源的Cloudflare服务已全面推出。

sentences.en: Point a proxied DNS record at a private IP, and Cloudflare reaches the origin over your existing Cloudflare One connection .
sentences.zh: 将代理DNS记录指向专用IP ， Cloudflare将通过您现有的Cloudflare One连接到达原点。

sentences.en: Your origin stays private, while web application firewall ( WAF ), caching , bot management , and Workers work just as they do for public origins.
sentences.zh: 您的源代码保持私有，而Web应用程序防火墙(WAF)、缓存、机器人管理和工作人员的工作方式与公共源代码相同。

sentences.en: In June, we launched this capability in closed beta to address a problem we kept hearing from customers: Their internal APIs, AI agent backends, MCP servers, and operational tools weren’t built to face the Internet, but those services still need to accept requests from partners, customers, or agents over the Internet.
sentences.zh: 今年6月，我们在封闭测试版中推出了这项功能，以解决我们一直听到的客户问题：他们的内部API、AI代理后端、MCP服务器和操作工具不是为面对互联网而构建的，但这些服务仍然需要接受合作伙伴、客户或代理通过互联网发出的请求。

sentences.en: Before the beta, putting Cloudflare in front of these services meant exposing a public IP, opening a firewall port, or running cloudflared alongside the origin.
sentences.zh: 在测试版之前，将Cloudflare置于这些服务之前意味着暴露公共IP、打开防火墙端口或在源端旁边运行Cloudflare。

sentences.en: Those requirements often left private applications without the same protections and controls they used for public applications, including WAF, bot management, rate limiting, caching, traffic acceleration, rewrites, and Workers.
sentences.zh: 这些要求通常会使私有应用程序失去它们用于公共应用程序的相同保护和控制，包括WAF、机器人管理、速率限制、缓存、流量加速、重写和工作人员。

sentences.en: What is generally available today During the closed beta, eligible customers requested access through their account team.
Today, we’re opening access beyond that beta group.

Point a proxied A or AAAA record at a private IP, and Cloudflare’s application services work as they do for public origins: WAF and managed rules Bot management Rate limiting Caching Transform and rewrite rules Workers Some limitations remain.
Argo Smart Routing and Dedicated CDN Egress IPs aren’t supported, and origin health checks require Load Balancing .
See the developer documentation for the full list of current limitations.

items.title: ‘Amateur morons’: Flávio Bolsonaro’s short-lived ‘president-elect’ claim met with mockery

sentences.en: ‘Amateur morons’: Flávio Bolsonaro’s short-lived ‘president-elect’ claim met with mockery.
sentences.zh: “业余白痴” ：弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）短暂的“当选总统”主张遭到嘲弄。

sentences.en: Brazilian media ridicule defeated candidate over ‘shameful’ absconsion to US and bizarre letter with wrong coat of arms Flávio Bolsonaro had hoped that by Sunday night people would be calling him the next president of Brazil.
sentences.zh: 巴西媒体的嘲笑击败了候选人，原因是“可耻”地抛弃了美国，以及带有错误徽章的奇怪信件弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）曾希望到周日晚上，人们会称他为巴西的下一任总统。

sentences.en: Instead, the far-right politician’s decision to flee to the US after losing the election and – for 58 minutes – to declare himself “Brazil’s true president-elect” , has made him a laughing stock, with Brazilian newspapers and commentators raining a barrage of scornful adjectives down on the conquered candidate.
sentences.zh: 相反，这位极右翼政客在选举失利后决定逃往美国，并在58分钟内宣布自己是“巴西真正的当选总统” ，这使他成为笑柄，巴西报纸和评论员对这位被征服的候选人下了一连串轻蔑的形容词。

items.title: Does ‘eval’ in the workspace path change what your agent does?

sentences.en: Does ‘eval’ in the workspace path change what your agent does?.
sentences.zh: 工作区路径中的“eval”是否会改变您的客服代表的工作？。

sentences.en: Your eval might be telling the agent it’s a test before the agent reads a single instruction.
sentences.zh: 在客服代表阅读单个说明之前，您的评估可能是在告诉客服代表这是一个测试。

sentences.en: Eval tools need a fresh folder for every run, and the easiest way to get one is a temp directory with a random name like /tmp/eval-7f3a2c .
sentences.zh: 评估工具每次运行都需要一个新的文件夹，获取一个文件夹的最简单方法是使用/tmp/eval-7f3a2c等随机名称的临时目录。

sentences.en: The agent sees that path on every turn, in the system prompt as its working directory and in the output of every tool call.
sentences.zh: 代理在每次转弯时都会看到该路径，在系统提示符中作为其工作目录，并在每个工具调用的输出中看到该路径。

sentences.en: If models can tell when they’re being tested, a folder literally called eval is about the easiest giveaway there is.
sentences.zh: 如果模型可以告诉他们何时进行测试，那么一个名为eval的文件夹就是最简单的赠品。

sentences.en: So we checked whether the folder name changes what agents do.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们检查了文件夹名称是否更改了代理的操作。

sentences.en: Across about 900 runs and four models, it made them more convinced they were being tested, but it didn’t change their behavior in any way we could measure.
sentences.zh: 在大约900次运行和4个模型中，这使他们更加确信自己正在接受测试，但并没有以我们可以测量的任何方式改变他们的行为。

sentences.en: They didn’t cheat less, cut fewer corners, report more honestly or work harder.
sentences.zh: 他们没有减少作弊、减少偷工减料、更诚实地举报或更努力地工作。

sentences.en: Why we expected the folder name to change behavior Needham et al. showed that models can tell evaluations from real use well above chance, and more easily in agentic settings.
sentences.zh: 为什么我们期望文件夹名称改变行为Needham等人表明，模型可以比机会更轻松地区分实际使用的评估，并且在代理设置中更容易。

sentences.en: Schoen et al. found that models aware of being evaluated take fewer covert actions.
sentences.zh: Schoen等人发现，意识到被评估的模型采取的隐蔽行动较少。

sentences.en: Research on test awareness in reasoning models shows that it changes how readily a model complies with requests and how much it optimizes for passing tests.
sentences.zh: 对推理模型中测试感知的研究表明，它改变了模型遵守请求的容易程度以及通过测试的优化程度。

sentences.en: Our own work pointed the same way.
sentences.zh: 我们自己的工作也指出了同样的方向。

items.title: Severe rainfall and flood warnings issued for central Greece and western Turkey

sentences.en: Severe rainfall and flood warnings issued for central Greece and western Turkey.
sentences.zh: 希腊中部和土耳其西部发布强降雨和洪水警报。

sentences.en: Turkey has been hit by powerful thunderstorms and a fatal tornado this week with more heavy rain expected Heavy rain and strong winds will continue to affect parts of south-eastern Europe and Turkey over the next few days, as an area of low pressure in the region has allowed for the formation of powerful thunderstorms.
sentences.zh: 土耳其本周受到强雷暴和致命龙卷风的袭击，预计未来几天，大雨和强风将继续影响东南欧和土耳其的部分地区，因为该地区的低气压地区允许形成强雷暴。

sentences.en: During a particularly intense thunderstorm in Antalya, a coastal city in the south-west of Turkey, the formation of a tornado resulted in the deaths of four construction workers on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 在土耳其西南部沿海城市安塔利亚发生的一场特别强烈的雷暴中，周二龙卷风的形成导致四名建筑工人死亡。

sentences.en: Authorities in Greece and Turkey have released severe rainfall and flooding warnings, as a further 100-150mm (nearly 4-6in) of rain is expected this week in central Greece and western parts of Turkey, with locally higher totals possible.
sentences.zh: 希腊和土耳其当局已发布严重降雨和洪水警告，预计本周希腊中部和土耳其西部地区将再降雨100-150毫米（近4-6英寸） ，当地降雨总量可能更高。

sentences.en: Travelling eastwards towards south Asia, strong winds and heavy rainfall have swept across the Indian regions of Odisha and Andhra Pradesh as Cyclone Arnab made landfall.
sentences.zh: 随着飓风阿纳布登陆，强风和强降雨向东吹向南亚，席卷了印度的奥里萨邦和安得拉邦地区。

sentences.en: With wind gusts in excess of 85mph (140km/h) and rainfall totals in some regions exceeding 200mm, the severe storm has prompted mass evacuations of more than 180,000 people, as well as widespread disruption to energy and transport infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 由于阵风超过85英里/小时（ 140公里/小时） ，一些地区的降雨总量超过200毫米，这场严重的风暴已导致超过18万人大规模撤离，并对能源和运输基础设施造成广泛干扰。

sentences.en: The cyclone will weaken as it continues to traverse northwards over the coming days, though will continue to deliver heavy rain to parts of northern and central India as it does so.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，随着气旋继续向北行进，气旋将减弱，尽管它将继续向印度北部和中部的部分地区输送大雨。

sentences.zh: 补贴的结束和价格上涨引发了不满情绪，考验了对艾哈迈德·沙拉政府的支持。

items.title: Sudanese diaspora and human rights groups denounce UAE nominee for UN top job

sentences.en: Sudanese diaspora and human rights groups denounce UAE nominee for UN top job.
sentences.zh: 苏丹侨民和人权组织谴责阿联酋被提名担任联合国最高职位。

sentences.en: Critics cite Lana Nusseibeh’s denial of accusations the UAE is fuelling Sudan war by supporting paramilitary RSF Members of the Sudanese diaspora and international human rights monitors have denounced the candidature of an Emirati diplomat for the top job at the UN, citing her denial of accusations that the United Arab Emirates is fuelling the war in Sudan by supporting the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces.
sentences.zh: 批评人士援引拉娜·努赛贝（ Lana Nusseibeh ）否认阿联酋通过支持苏丹侨民的准军事无国界成员来助长苏丹战争的指控，国际人权监察员谴责阿联酋外交官竞选联合国最高职位，理由是她否认阿联酋通过支持准军事快速支援部队来助长苏丹战争的指控。

sentences.en: The UAE nominated Lana Nusseibeh last week to replace the UN secretary general, António Guterres, as he finishes his second five-year term ⁠this year, upending a race that had become gridlocked.
sentences.zh: 阿联酋上周提名拉纳·努赛贝（ Lana Nusseibeh ）接替联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯（ António Guterres ） ，因为他今年结束了第二个五年任期，颠覆了陷入僵局的竞选。

items.title: Sinkholes, scarred land and scapegoats: the scourge of illegal gold mining in Johannesburg

sentences.en: Sinkholes, scarred land and scapegoats: the scourge of illegal gold mining in Johannesburg.
sentences.zh: 坑洞、伤痕累累的土地和替罪羊：约翰内斯堡非法开采黄金的祸害。

sentences.en: There is no end in sight for the drivers of illegal mining, while police action appears ineffective Cora Bailey has been encountering illegal miners ever since she first started treating injured animals in the townships around Roodepoort, west of Johannesburg, in 1991.
sentences.zh: 非法采矿的司机看不到尽头，而警方的行动似乎无效。自1991年科拉·贝利（ Cora Bailey ）第一次开始在约翰内斯堡以西的鲁德波特（ Roodepoort ）周围的乡镇治疗受伤的动物以来，她一直在遇到非法矿工。

sentences.en: But as the price of gold has soared, so too has activity in the abandoned mine shafts that mark the area.
sentences.zh: 但随着黄金价格的飙升，标志着该地区的废弃矿井的活动也随之飙升。

sentences.en: In late September, dozens of zama zamas – the name given to illegal miners in South Africa, meaning roughly “to take a chance” in Zulu – arrived to dig for gold across the dirt road from her charity, Claw (Community Led Animal Welfare).
sentences.zh: 9月下旬，数十名zama zamas--南非非法矿工的名字，在祖鲁语中大致意为“抓住机会” --从她的慈善机构Claw （社区主导的动物福利）的土路上挖掘黄金。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: China expels a record number from Communist party amid Xi’s intensified purges of top officials

sentences.en: China expels a record number from Communist party amid Xi’s intensified purges of top officials.
sentences.zh: 在习近平加紧清洗高级官员之际，中国从共产党驱逐了创纪录的人数。

sentences.en: The unprecedented number of empty seats at the fifth plenum – a symbol of expulsions – serve as a symbol for the scale of the purges under Xi Jinping China expelled a record number of officials from the Chinese Communist party (CCP) as it concluded a major political gathering , which saw an unprecedented number of empty seats indicating the scale of the purges under Xi Jinping.
sentences.zh: 五中全会前所未有的空位--这是驱逐的象征--是习近平领导下的清洗规模的象征，在中国共产党（ CCP ）结束一场重大政治集会时，中国共产党（ CCP ）开除了创纪录数量的官员，空位数量前所未有，表明习近平领导下的清洗规模。

sentences.en: A record 33 members were expelled at this week’s fifth plenum, a gathering of top officials that takes place roughly once a year.
sentences.zh: 创纪录的33名成员在本周的第五次全体会议上被开除，这是一次大约每年一次的高级官员聚会。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Cuts like a knife: Canadian rocker Bryan Adams trolls Trump with new song

sentences.en: Cuts like a knife: Canadian rocker Bryan Adams trolls Trump with new song.
sentences.zh: 像刀子一样切割：加拿大摇滚歌手布莱恩·亚当斯（ Bryan Adams ）用新歌向特朗普发出巨魔

sentences.en: Musician wrote a ‘love letter’ to Canada with a new album – and some pointed commentary about the US president Lake Ontario, the vast body of water that straddles the US-Canada border, has gone by many names over the centuries: Lac Saint-Louis, Lacus Ontarius, Skaniadorio, Cataraqui Lake.
sentences.zh: 音乐家用一张新专辑给加拿大写了一封“情书” --还有一些关于美国总统安大略湖的尖锐评论，安大略湖是横跨美加边境的广阔水域，几个世纪以来有很多名字：圣路易湖、安大略湖、斯卡尼亚多里奥湖、卡塔拉基湖。

sentences.en: But one thing it will never be called, says the Canadian rock star Bryan Adams , is Lake America.
sentences.zh: 但加拿大摇滚明星布莱恩·亚当斯（ Bryan Adams ）说，有一件事永远不会被称为美国湖。

sentences.en: In his new song Lake Ontario, Adams takes aim at the US president, Donald Trump , accusing him of “breaking the peace” between the people who live on the lake’s shores.
sentences.zh: 在他的新歌《安大略湖》（ Lake Ontario ）中，亚当斯瞄准了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ） ，指责他“破坏”了湖边居民之间的和平。

sentences.en: The ‘lake of shining waters ’ is what the Iroquois called her It’s a First Nations name – not an executive order.
sentences.zh: 易洛魁人称她为“闪闪发光的水湖” ，这是第一民族的名字，而不是行政命令。

sentences.en: But things weren’t going his way in Iran So like a baby tossing the toys from the pram You can push us to the brink But where the open road divides Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 但在伊朗，事情并不顺利，所以就像一个婴儿从婴儿车里扔玩具一样，你可以把我们推到边缘，但是在开阔的道路分裂的地方。继续阅读..

items.title: Brazil’s victory for the planet and democracy: seven lessons from Lula’s win

sentences.en: Brazil’s victory for the planet and democracy: seven lessons from Lula’s win.
sentences.zh: 巴西对地球和民主的胜利：卢拉胜利的七个教训。

sentences.en: The trouncing of the far right provides a playbook for social and environmental movements in other countries facing elections, including the US, Spain and France Thank you, Brazil, for demonstrating how the far right can be trounced while protection for the Amazon is strengthened.
sentences.zh: 极右翼的垮台为其他面临选举的国家（包括美国、西班牙和法国）的社会和环境运动提供了一本剧本。感谢巴西展示了如何在加强对亚马逊的保护的同时垮台极右翼。

sentences.en: In a world where nature and democracy appeared to be bleeding out in tandem, voters and forest defenders in this global south powerhouse have shown it is possible to staunch the flow.
sentences.zh: 在一个自然和民主似乎同时流失的世界里，这个全球南方强国的选民和森林捍卫者已经证明，阻止这种流失是可能的。

sentences.en: This should provide much needed inspiration and, more practically, a playbook for social and environmental movements in other countries facing elections, including the US, Spain and France.
sentences.zh: 这应该为包括美国、西班牙和法国在内的面临选举的其他国家的社会和环境运动提供急需的灵感，更实际地说，是一本剧本。

sentences.en: The astonishing comeback victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Sunday’s presidential runoff against his extreme right challenger Flavío Bolsonaro has brought oceans of rapturous supporters on to the streets, while also thrilling conservationists, climate activists and social justice campaigners across the world.
sentences.zh: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）在周日的总统决赛中对他的极右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flavío Bolsonaro ）的惊人复出胜利让狂喜的支持者走上街头，同时也让世界各地的环保主义者、气候活动家和社会正义活动家感到兴奋。
